taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station H-06, survey area H. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 609.8 | 18.27 | 18.27
2 | 213.6 | 1.05 | 19.32
3 | 1311.8 | 4.54 | 23.86
4 | 278.0 | 3.10 | 26.96
5 | 1124.7 | 1.46 | 28.42
6 | 291.6 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation, we analyze the resistivity of each layer in groups of three consecutive layers.

**Resistivities:**
- Layer 1 ($r_1$): 609.8 $\Omega\text{-m}$
- Layer 2 ($r_2$): 213.6 $\Omega\text{-m}$
- Layer 3 ($r_3$): 1311.8 $\Omega\text{-m}$
- Layer 4 ($r_4$): 278.0 $\Omega\text{-m}$
- Layer 5 ($r_5$): 1124.7 $\Omega\text{-m}$
- Layer 6 ($r_6$): 291.6 $\Omega\text{-m}$

**Analyzing the groups of three:**
1.  **Layers 1-2-3:** $609.8 > 213.6 < 1311.8$ ($r_1 > r_2 < r_3$). This corresponds to the letter **H**.
2.  **Layers 2-3-4:** $213.6 < 1311.8 > 278.0$ ($r_2 < r_3 > r_4$). This corresponds to the letter **K**.
3.  **Layers 3-4-5:** $1311.8 > 278.0 < 1124.7$ ($r_3 > r_4 < r_5$). This corresponds to the letter **H**.
4.  **Layers 4-5-6:** $278.0 < 1124.7 > 291.6$ ($r_4 < r_5 > r_6$). This corresponds to the letter **K**.

The resulting sequence of letters is HKHK.

{"curve_type": "HKHK"}
